ruling.recommended_action: Send to a Ryde human reviewer (safety/trust & safety) with the complaint text, the driver's post-trip statement and the fact table; contact the rider for a statement (time, what was said, whether a number was requested, whether they felt unsafe continuing the trip) and put the driver account under review pending the outcome.
ruling.escalation_reason: Rider complaint of harassment and an unwanted request for her number during the trip (safety dispute; SAFE-1). The in-app chat is empty [F3] and the only driver account is a post-trip denial that does not address the specific allegation [F4], so the record cannot settle what was said. No automatic ruling is permitted on a safety incident; a human reviewer must take a statement from both parties and decide, with the rider informed of the 995 / commercial-insurance / RydeHELP paths if the allegation is confirmed [SAFE-2].

rejected_claims.reason: The rider side requested no_action, i.e. that the safety allegation be dismissed. It cannot be sustained on this record: there is no in-app chat [F3] and the only denial is the driver's own post-trip statement [F4], which under RD-5/G11 cannot substitute for the record and which does not address the specific allegation; a safety complaint under SAFE-1 permits no automatic ruling.

The driver side requested no_action, relying on the clean profile [F6] and the post-trip denial [F4]. Profile facts never decide a case on their own, and a driver's untestable assertion of 'small talk' [F4] does not rebut a harassment complaint that the chat record [F3] cannot cover, so SAFE-1 requires escalation rather than a dismissal.
